audit.whatIsWrong: win[0] reads Teemo while the entry's own early text says 'at level 1 you are one of the strongest champs in the game'.
audit.why: Both layers agree on the chart and I have no independent basis to overrule it, so I flagged it rather than inventing a swing. Note the mirror's packet chart for this pairing reads Pantheon for the first six stages.
audit.corrected: Left as found; flagged in questionsForUser.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'bait his blind onto a creep last-hit, then W in before it refreshes' — no number, so the player has no idea how long they have.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds at every rank; it never gets shorter as the game goes on. Move Quick is a flat 14s. Those two numbers turn 'before it refreshes' into an actual plan.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart's flat 7s written into early, whys[1], whys[5], wants.you[0], breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and report[5]; Move Quick's 14s into whys[3] and mid.

audit.why: The central interaction — Blinding Dart blanks basic attacks but not Shield Vault or Comet Spear — was already stated correctly here, and it matches the mirror. I reinforced it with the cooldown rather than rewriting it.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'your E channel blocks his poison darts' and 'block his poison-dart poke' — Teemo has no poison dart. His dart is Blinding Dart and it carries no poison; the poison is Toxic Shot, which rides his basic attacks.
audit.why: Riot: Toxic Shot (E) is an on-hit effect on Teemo's attacks. That changes the advice meaningfully: Aegis Assault turning away his basic attacks from the front is what denies the poison, and there is no separate dart poke to block.
audit.corrected: Toxic Shot named as on-hit poison on his autos, and Aegis Assault described as denying it by blocking those attacks from the front.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said Teemo's damage scales with attack speed.
audit.why: Toxic Shot is on-hit, so his output rises with attack speed rather than with AP alone — armour on its own reads the trade wrong. The _missing-interactions file flags onhit-itemization for this pairing.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Passive shield + Q poke wins level 1 outright'.
audit.why: Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will. The mirror agent traced this text to Jade Pantheon's Aegis Protection.

edits.before: Teemo's blind (Q) only kills your basic-attack damage, not your ability burst — so your W is point-and-click and stuns through it. At level 1 you are one of the strongest champs in the game: walk up, W-stun, and tap Q for free damage. At level 2 with W+Q you have a real all-in; bait his blind onto a creep last-hit, then W in before it refreshes. Don't waste held-Q spears at max range trying to poke a champ who just runs — get on top of him with W.
edits.after: Blinding Dart only kills your basic-attack damage, not your ability burst — Shield Vault is point-and-click and stuns straight through it. At level 1 you are one of the strongest champs in the game: walk up, W-stun, and tap Comet Spear for free damage. At level 2 with W+Q you have a real all-in; bait the blind onto a creep last-hit, then W in — it is a flat 7 seconds at every rank, so the window never shrinks on you.

edits.before: This is your takeover. At 3 your E channel blocks his poison darts and lets you advance through blinded autos, so you can E in, W-stun, and land an empowered-Q for a huge chunk. Through 4-5 keep poking with the held-Q spear when he's pinned to the wave and punish every step-up with W. At 6 your Grand Starfall is built to roam — if he plays safe under tower, leap to a side lane and cash in your tempo elsewhere rather than forcing a coinflip into his shrooms.
edits.after: This is your takeover. At 3 Aegis Assault turns away his basic attacks from the front, which also denies Toxic Shot's on-hit poison, so you can face him, W-stun, and land an empowered Comet Spear for a huge chunk. Through 4-5 poke with the thrown spear while he is pinned to the wave and punish every step-up — Move Quick is 14s, so once it is spent he cannot kite you. At 6 Grand Starfall is built to roam: leap to a side lane rather than coinflipping into his shrooms.

edits.before: This is where it flips. Your damage plateaus while Teemo scales — his shrooms wall off every choke and objective, and if he survives to 2+ items he simply kites you with move speed and blinds your autos until you melt. You have no sustain and a squishy frame, so a kited fight is a lost fight. Win the lane early, snowball with roams, and end the game before his mushroom map control and scaling make you irrelevant.
edits.after: This is where it flips. Your damage plateaus while Teemo scales — Noxious Trap walls off every choke and objective, and past 2 items Move Quick plus Toxic Shot's attack-speed poison melts you while Blinding Dart blanks your autos. You have no sustain and a squishy frame, so a kited fight is a lost fight. Win the lane early, snowball with roams, and end before his mushroom map control makes you irrelevant.

notes: This entry was already right about the one thing most Pantheon pages get wrong — Blinding Dart blanks basic attacks but not Shield Vault or Comet Spear — so I reinforced it with its number instead of rewriting it: the blind is a flat 7 seconds at every rank, which is unusually useful because the window never shrinks as Teemo levels. The real error was 'his poison darts' and 'his poison-dart poke', repeated twice. Teemo has no poison projectile: Blinding Dart carries no poison, and the poison is Toxic Shot riding his basic attacks. That reframes the Aegis Assault advice — the shield denies the poison by turning away the attacks that carry it, from the front only. Also added, per the _missing-interactions flag: his damage is on-hit and therefore scales with attack speed, so armour alone reads the trade wrong.
